desc: convert a PPM image into an Atari Degas .pi1 file
r: ppmtopi1 - convert a PPM image into an Atari Degas .pi1 file

This program is part of Netpbm(1).

ppmtopi1 reads a PPM image as input and produces an Atari Degas .pi1 file as output.

There are no command line options defined specifically for ppmtopi1, but it recognizes the options common to all programs based on libnetpbm (See
Common Options .)
